text:
sahil: Heads-up — we just saw a spike in Pro tier conversions after the pricing change this morning. Predictive model flags ~2.4x GPU-hr demand over baseline for next 72h. Can infra buy headroom or reallocate? :eyes:
mina: got the alert. can you paste the forecast numbers?
sahil: quick snapshot from the pipeline: 
```
72h window: +1400 GPU-hrs (p99)
Peak hour: +220 GPU-hrs
EU-west impact: ~60% of new sessions routed to eu-west
Estimated cost delta: ~$18k additional GPU spend (on current pricing)
```
mina: ouch. EU-west is currently at 95% reserved on A100 pool. we have ~30 spare nodes in us-west to move but networking egress will add latency for EU customers.
josh: we can hot-add 20 reserved GPUs to eu-west from our spare contract with partner infra, but lead is ~3h to provision. ops-bot: @channel provisioning request queued: ticket #INF-4920. ETA: 3h.
eli: routing note — if we route new Pro traffic to a proxied us-west pool, p95 latency increases ~60ms per request. for chat workloads that might be borderline. also need to check KV cache locality impact.
rebecca (sales): This is coming from a delayed billing opt-in for several enterprise customers — they're switching to Pro mid-week. Do we have short-term capacity commitment from them? I can ping for 1-2 week reserved commit if that helps cover costs.
sahil: please ping them, rebecca. In parallel, two asks for infra: (1) prioritize eu-west additional capacity; (2) apply a temporary soft quota for new Pro signups that throttles token rate to 0.8x until we stabilize.
mina: for (2) we can implement a quota gate via rate-limiter rule: `pro_rate_limit_soft = 0.8 * default_pro_rate` — low risk and reversible. I can ship change in ~30m.
josh: provisioning partner contract approved — starting allocation request now. will confirm when nodes are live.
capacity-forecast-bot: New forecast revision applied. Updated expected incremental GPU-hrs: +1350 (median) / +1600 (p90) / +2200 (p99) over 72h.
eli: also flagging that network egress budget for eu-west will increase ~2.2x during this event; finance will need a heads-up.
rebecca (sales): pinged the customers for temporary reserved commits. Two responded — one can commit 30% of projected usage for 2 weeks. sending contract terms now.
sahil: plan: mina to deploy soft quota, josh to confirm eu-west add, rebecca to secure short reserves. I'll update leadership + product about potential fallback to smaller-quantized model variants if we can't stabilize. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-127. Assigned: eng-infra oncall.
mina: rolling quota change in 5m. monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/pro/quota-events
sahil: keep p95 latency and GPU utilization in #eng-sre as we roll. if anything looks off escalate to oncall.
